lane: Qwen3.6 27B AutoRound INT4, MTP speculative, 2x Intel Arc Pro B70, vLLM/XPU TP2
suite: 25-prompt validation suite, 512 max tokens, conventional 99-interval median, all rows cached_tokens=0

headline.reason: no configuration exceeded the retained 95.385 July figure while also reproducing itself token-for-token
headline.deterministic_ceiling_note: raised from 92.003 by the masked-max greedy tie break (vllm 44fc8fde09); median of three replicates 94.321/94.710/94.791

source_identity.vllm_head_note: was 95a76ff891; two sampler commits added 2026-08-18: 011713d34b removes the full-vocab fp32 copy, 44fc8fde09 replaces topk(k=2) with two masked max reductions

determinism_flag_conjunction.finding: run-to-run token reproducibility requires ALL four flag families simultaneously; removing any one degrades it

arms.flags_removed: deterministic greedy margin, both batch-invariant flags
margin, both batch-invariant flags, all four oneDNN barrier/dependency flags

arms.verdict: fourth draft position accepts only 33%; serial-exact GDN is hardcoded to four verifier rows and must be disabled for MTP4, which costs more determinism than the depth gains

arms.description: non-speculative reference, compiled PIECEWISE with cudagraph_capture_sizes pinned to [4] instead of [1,2,4,8]
arms.verdict: KEEP. Pinning capture to a single shape improved reference self-consistency from 15/25 to 24/25 and made the oracle run 3.9x faster than the eager oracle at 11.65 tok/s

cross_configuration_parity.finding: token-identical output is achievable only between reruns of an identical configuration
cross_configuration_parity.control: two non-speculative eager references differing only in the deterministic-margin flag agree on 8/25 prompts
cross_configuration_parity.implication: a gate requiring a candidate to be token-identical to a differently-configured reference is unsatisfiable at float16 on this stack

xpu_batch_invariance_defects.defect: batch-invariant linear path is gated on current_platform.is_cuda_alike(), which is false for PlatformEnum.XPU; VLLM_XPU_LINEAR_BATCH_INVARIANT is computed at line 228 then discarded by the same conjunct
same is_cuda_alike() gate disables batch-invariant LM head on XPU; the INT8 LM head path returns at line 406 before reaching it
batch-invariant RMSNorm lives in forward_cuda/forward_xpu; under compiled custom_ops=['none'] dispatch goes to forward_native and never reaches it
VALIDATION_INT4_GEMM_FIXED_M4 and VALIDATION_INT8_LM_HEAD_FIXED_M4 export env vars that no code in vllm or vllm-xpu-kernels reads; the consumer was never written

harness_defects.note: VALIDATION_GDN_NATIVE_SPEC_RECURRENT_SERIAL_EXACT defaults to 1 for spec arms, so it is silently on unless explicitly set to 0
raises 'exact recurrent proof requires one request with four verifier rows'; hardcoded to MTP3 and incompatible with any other draft depth
the source-identity guard pins vllm-xpu-kernels to 2dd55f38; syncing that repo with upstream silently disarms every validation arm with exit code 3

conclusion: On the full 25-prompt suite the deterministic configuration now reaches 94.710 tok/s (median of three replicates), up from 92.003, via a sampler change verified bit-identical to the original. Quality passes on all three and reproducibility is unchanged. The fastest non-reproducing configuration remains 96.822 tok/s, so determinism now costs about 2.1 tok/s rather than 4.8. Still below the retained 95.385 July figure, which was measured on a 12-prompt suite with no determinism gate, so no submission was made.

accepted.change: vllm/v1/sample/sampler.py: two masked max reductions instead of topk(k=2)
accepted.self_determinism: B vs C 25/25 identical over 12477 tokens; A vs B and A vs C 24/25, differing only at holdout--structured-extraction token 246, the same bistable prompt that is the sole flake in both reference oracles, which do not use this code path
accepted.equivalence: verified bit-identical to the previous implementation over 800 sampled tokens including forced exact ties and forced near ties

rejected.verdict: costs ~11 tok/s; correctness-lane tool, not a speed lever
no gain over all_target; the input-dependency flag is cheap at any scope
kept as a cleanup but worth only ~0.2 ms/step; topk itself was the cost
not applicable; VLLM_XPU_SPEC_GREEDY_TOP_IDS was never enabled in any arm, so the margin was not disabling it

source_publication.note: no bundle packet is needed; every pinned commit is reachable from these public refs
source_publication.staged_flash_attention: 3.1 GB of AOT SYCL binaries; not distributable and not bit-reproducible across oneAPI toolchains. The build recipe is published under experiments/qwen27_graphsafe_flash_attention/ (build.sh, three patches, validate.sh, graph-replay tests). The four SHA256 values prove a given host still runs the artifact it measured with; they are not a build target.
